WELCOME_BOT_TRIGGER.NO_TEMPLATE_WARNING: This flow's first step doesn't use an approved WhatsApp template -- if the patient hasn't messaged in the last 24h, the send may not go through.

TEMPLATE_LIBRARY.DESCRIPTION: Each template has a key and several versions. Only one version can be active at a time -- notifications and the welcome bot that reference it always use the active version.

RETURNING_PROMPT.DESCRIPTION: If a patient with an upcoming appointment (pending or confirmed) writes again on a different day and already has an agent assigned, the welcome bot never reaches them -- this sends a separate message asking if they want to reschedule, cancel, or talk to the front desk, once per appointment.
RETURNING_PROMPT.TEST_MODE_OFF: Live -- a real message is sent to the patient
RETURNING_PROMPT.TEST_MODE_HINT: While in test mode, a private note is saved instead of sending the message over WhatsApp.
RETURNING_PROMPT.TEMPLATE_PLACEHOLDER: No real buttons -- plain text only
RETURNING_PROMPT.TWILIO_TEMPLATE_HINT: If you don't pick one, the message is sent as plain text with the options listed below.

TRIGGERS.DESCRIPTION: Automatic WhatsApp messages when an appointment is created, its status changes, or before it starts.
TRIGGERS.NO_WHATSAPP_INBOX_WARNING: This account has no WhatsApp inbox configured -- connect a WhatsApp inbox first to create notifications.

KIND_VALUES.ON_STATUS_CHANGE_DELAYED: When status changes to "{status}" ({minutes} min later)

DELETE_CONFIRM.TITLE: Delete notification
DELETE_CONFIRM.MESSAGE: This notification will be removed. Appointments already created are not affected.

FORM.DELAY_MINUTES_HINT: Leave blank to send right away. Useful, for example, to send the "attended" or "no-show" message a while after the change instead of instantly.
FORM.SERVICE_HINT: Leave all unchecked to apply to every service.
FORM.PAYER_KIND_HINT: Leave all unchecked to apply to every payer type (EPS, private, plans, policies).
FORM.TEMPLATE_HINT: You can use appointment variables in the template parameters (contact.name, appointment.date, appointment.time, appointment.service_name, appointment.professional_name) by writing them inside double curly braces -- they're automatically replaced with each appointment's real data. For "on_reschedule" triggers only, appointment.previous_date/appointment.previous_time hold the date and time before the change.
FORM.NO_TEMPLATES: This inbox has no approved templates available. Sync Twilio templates from the channel settings.
FORM.TWILIO_TEMPLATE_HINT: Catalog of approved templates already synced from Twilio for this inbox.
FORM.TEST_MODE_LABEL: Test mode: send as a private note
FORM.TEST_MODE_HINT: Instead of sending the real WhatsApp message to the patient, a private note is created on the conversation with the content that would have been sent. Use this to test appointment creation, confirmations and reminders before turning on real sends.
FORM.TEST_MODE_FORCED_HINT: This inbox has no approved WhatsApp templates, so it can only send private notes for now.
FORM.MESSAGE_TEMPLATE_KEY_HINT: If filled with a key from the Template library tab, that version's active text replaces the free-text body above (used in test mode and in the preview note) -- activating a new version in the library changes the real message without editing this notification.

WELCOME_BOT.DESCRIPTION: Automatic triage bot: greets new WhatsApp conversations, asks a few questions, then hands off to a human.
WELCOME_BOT.EMPTY: No welcome bot flows configured yet.
WELCOME_BOT.FETCH_ERROR: Could not load the welcome bot flows.

DELETE_CONFIRM.TITLE: Delete flow
DELETE_CONFIRM.MESSAGE: This welcome bot flow will be removed. Conversations already handed off are not affected.

FORM.MATCH_TYPE_HINT: Only one "default" flow can be active per inbox -- it runs for any first message that does not match a keyword flow.

MATCH_TYPE_OPTIONS.KEYWORD: Only when the first message contains a keyword

FORM.PRIORITY_HINT: Keyword flows are checked from highest to lowest priority; the default flow is used only if none match.
FORM.STEP_ASK_TEMPLATE_HINT: Available variables (Liquid format, each wrapped in double braces): appointment.date, appointment.time, appointment.service_name, appointment.professional_name. Leave blank to use the generic message.
FORM.STEP_LOOKUP_OPTIONS_HINT: Options the patient will see (default: Reschedule / Cancel / Talk to reception). The following steps must condition on these same words.
FORM.STEP_CONTENT_SID_PLACEHOLDER: No real buttons (plain text with options)
FORM.STEP_CONTENT_SID_HINT: Catalog of Twilio templates already approved by Meta for this inbox. If you pick one, the patient sees real WhatsApp buttons instead of a plain-text list of options. The options above must match exactly the buttons of the chosen template.
FORM.STEP_CONTENT_SID_EMPTY: This inbox has no approved templates available. Sync Twilio templates from the channel settings.
FORM.STEP_CONTENT_SID_NOT_APPROVED: This step uses a template Twilio no longer reports as approved by Meta (it may never have been submitted, or got reclassified). Verify its status before trusting it to reach the patient as real buttons.
FORM.STEP_EMPTY_MESSAGE_LABEL: Message when no upcoming appointment is found
FORM.STEP_EMPTY_MESSAGE_PLACEHOLDER: e.g. We couldn't find any upcoming appointments for your number. Connecting you with reception.
FORM.STEP_WAITLIST_KEYWORD_HINT: This step must come right after a question with two options (waitlist / definitive cancellation). If the patient's reply contains this keyword, their waitlist entry is reactivated; otherwise the appointment is cancelled for good.
FORM.STEP_ACK_MESSAGE_PLACEHOLDER: e.g. Got it, connecting you with reception.
FORM.STEP_TEMPLATE_KEY_HINT: If filled with a key from the Template library tab, its active version replaces the text above -- activating a new version in the library changes the real message without editing this step.
FORM.STEP_CONDITION_LABEL: Only ask this if a previous answer matches
FORM.ESCALATION_MESSAGE_LABEL: Escalation message (if nobody answers the 2 reminders)
FORM.ESCALATION_MESSAGE_PLACEHOLDER: e.g. Hi, sorry for the delay. An advisor will assist you shortly.
FORM.ESCALATION_MESSAGE_HINT: Used as the final escalation message when no custom reminders are configured below (see "Reminders"). Leave blank to use a generic message.
FORM.REMINDER_SCHEDULE_HINT: The last reminder always escalates the conversation to an available agent. If you don't add any, the default behavior is used: 1 reminder after 5 minutes and escalation after 20.
FORM.REMINDER_MESSAGE_PLACEHOLDER: e.g. Still there? An agent will assist you shortly.
FORM.REMINDER_LAST_HINT: (this last one escalates to an agent)
